items.quote: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah
items.claim: Moses announced to the children of Israel that God called Bezaleel by name

items.quote: the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah
items.claim: God selected Bezaleel by name for sacred work

items.quote: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship
items.claim: God endowed Bezaleel with divine spirit and multiple forms of expertise
items.mechanism: the spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, knowledge, workmanship

items.quote: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass
items.claim: Skilled at devising intricate works and working with precious metals

items.quote: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work
items.claim: Skilled in stone cutting, stone-setting, and woodcarving
